mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status IN (1, 2) AND pay_time >= #{start}) AS salesAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status IN (1, 2) AND pay_time >= #{start}) AS paidOrderCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status = 2 AND pay_time >= #{start}) AS refundAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}) AS newUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS pendingShip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_after_sale WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) AS pendingAfterSale

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status IN (1, 2) AND pay_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, IFNULL(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS amount, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS qty FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_status IN (1, 2) AND o.pay_time >= #{start} JOIN tb_sku s ON s.id = oi.sku_id JOIN tb_product p ON p.id = s.product_id JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) AS amount FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.pay_status IN (1, 2) AND o.pay_time >= #{start} JOIN tb_sku s ON s.id = oi.sku_id JOIN tb_product p ON p.id = s.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.name AS productName, s.spec_name AS spec, s.stock AS stock FROM tb_sku s JOIN tb_product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelf_status = 1 AND s.stock < #{threshold} ORDER BY s.stock ASC LIMIT 20
